summary: Comprehensive testing of IdeaRadar MVP - backend (20/20 tests passing) and frontend all key flows verified

issues: User who upgraded via /api/subscription/upgrade shows 'Current Plan' on Pro tier correctly, but Free tier shows 'Your current plan' which may be confusing for non-premium users - minor UX issue

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 744 lines - borderline but acceptable for MVP

The /api/ideas/{idea_id}/landing-copy and /api/ideas/{idea_id}/brief both increment free_briefs_used separately - a user could use 1 brief AND 1 landing copy totaling 2 uses before hitting the paywall (limit check is >= 1 but increments separately). This may be intentional design but should be clarified.
JWT_SECRET has fallback hardcoded value 'idearadar-secret' - should be required env var in production
seed_data_creation: 15 seed ideas already in DB from server startup
